eligibility: Combined family income not exceeding P400,000 annually
Not a recipient of other government scholarships
requirements: Income documents (ITR or Certificate of Indigency)
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Check with your school's scholarship office for application period Administered through CHED regional offices; priority for low-income families

scholarships.name: Unilever Philippines Scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Check Unilever Philippines website for announcements Focus on business, engineering, and chemistry courses

scholarships.name: University of the Philippines - SLAS Grants-in-Aid Program
benefits: Tuition waivers and allowances depending on donor and campus program
Need-based support through UP SLAS workflows
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Periodic SLAS windows; check campus OSG schedules.

scholarships.name: University of the Philippines - TES via SLAS
benefits: Cash subsidy and tuition support depending on TES allocation and eligibility
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Coordinated with SLAS application windows.

scholarships.name: UP DOST-SEI Scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Pass DOST-SEI exam first; UP admission separate Must qualify for both DOST-SEI and UP admission separately

scholarships.name: UP Iskolar ng Bayan (Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education)
benefits: Free tuition and other school fees
Free health service at UP infirmary
coverage: Full tuition coverage at all UP campuses
requirements: UP College Admission Test (UPCAT) passer or equivalent
No separate application needed for FHE
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Automatic upon enrollment; UPCAT is the entry point UP's socialized tuition scheme (STS) covers additional expenses for low-income students

scholarships.name: UP Oblation Scholarship
eligibility: Top examinees of the UP College Admission Test (UPCAT)
requirements: Top UPCAT scorer per campus or program
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Automatic; awarded to top UPCAT passers Prestige merit scholarship with no separate application.

scholarships.name: UP Socialized Tuition and Financial Assistance Program (STFAP)
eligibility: UP students who apply for socialized tuition bracketing
benefits: Tuition discount or free tuition depending on bracket
requirements: Submit income documentation for STFAP or socialized tuition assessment
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Before each semester enrollment cycle Tuition socialization support, not a traditional merit-only scholarship.

scholarships.name: UST San Lorenzo Ruiz Student Assistance Scholarship
eligibility: Willing to serve as student assistant (20-30 hours/week)
benefits: Monthly stipend for student assistant work
requirements: Willingness to work as student assistant
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Apply through UST Scholarship Office Work-study program for financially challenged students

scholarships.name: UST Santo Tomas Academic Scholarship
benefits: Tuition discount based on academic performance
Up to full tuition for top scholars
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Apply through UST Office for Admissions Based on USTET performance and academic records

scholarships.name: Valenzuela City Scholarship Program
scholarships.deadlineNotes: Check Valenzuela City Government website for announcements Supports scholars at Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Valenzuela
